Turning routine bureaucratic immigration enforcement into a gladiatorial social media spectacle trivializes the rule of law for personal clout.

The plane error confuses WHAT (administrative deportation) with WHO (online personalities claiming credit). It is a classic social media clout bait-and-switch.

Instead of transparent policy debate, figures weaponize state apparatuses for personal attention, projecting power they do not hold to dominate the discourse.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between sensationalist online claims and bureaucratic reality, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil through clout manipulation.

The Unavoidable Truth: Overstaying a visa legally triggers removal regardless of internet feuds.

The Unavoidable Lie: Online influencers dictate federal immigration enforcement actions.
